title: Private Kananaskis Two-Trail Hiking Adventure From Banff/Canmore
includes: Private, door-to-door transport in an air-conditioned vehicle
Lunch and refreshments including drinking water refills
Hiking poles and microspikes/ice cleats (if winter conditions)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Itinerary Note: exact routes, timings, and destinations may vary based on participant preferences, fitness levels, real-time mountain conditions, and safety.
Child Seats: required by law for under 6yrs (≤18kg). Not provided; please bring your own if needed.

Lunch is a grazing spread consisting of local meats, cheeses, and accompaniments or a deli-style lunch, depending on availability. We are unable to cater for specific dietary requirements or severe allergies; guests with specific nutritional needs are welcome to bring their own lunch.
Personal Gear: Please bring a small daypack, sun protection, and a reusable water bottle (refills provided).
Technical Gear: We provide hiking poles and microspikes/ice cleats if needed. USB-A charging ports are available in the van—please bring your own cable.

Clothing & Footwear: Wear sturdy, waterproof hiking boots (insulated for winter) and adaptable layers (avoid cotton). Bring an extra base layer to change into for the return journey (especially in summer). Check weather conditions before departure.
Waiver: required for all guests before departure.

Flexibility & Changes: If you need to amend your date or start time, please message us directly as far in advance as possible, and we will do everything we can to accommodate your request. Depending on guide availability, we can usually be highly adaptable.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
THE ADVENTURE:
Experience the perfect contrast of Kananaskis, whether you seek a high-elevation climb for 360° views or gentler trails to the serene lakes and forested falls of the valley floor. This private, two-hike journey allows you to find your rhythm in pristine wilderness, pairing iconic landscapes with active discovery. Tailor your day by choosing any two trail types from our curated favorites.

- Private tour (max. 11 guests)
- Duration: ~9 hrs
- Door-to-door transport from anywhere in Banff or Canmore, with park passes included
- Picnic lunch & refreshments provided
- Difficulty: Easy to Challenging (customizable).

ABOUT MOLARI:
As a family-run boutique, we prioritize a safe, ethical, and immersive approach to sharing the beauty of Western Canada:

- Private, tailored experiences only
- Founder-led journeys – your guide isn't "just here for the season"
- Our van: high-roof design, all-wheel drive, and remote start AC/heat
- Fully licensed, insured, and permitted.
